answer_1.quote: We extend standard LLM-as-a-Judge baselines with external validation tools based on web-search and code execution... across a range of response domains that are typically challenging... (1) long-form factual, (2) advanced coding, and (3) math responses.
answer_1.outputs: Model responses for factual, coding, and math tasks

answer_3.quote: Given a prompt and two possible responses, the annotator decides which response is "better". This pairwise judgement can be used for evaluation... or to provide feedback for training... AI annotators, also referred to as LLM-as-a-Judge, are used to collect such feedback.

answer_4.quote: We further collect human preference annotations from 3 annotators over the entire new dataset...
